description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for user-related actions such as registration, login, password recovery, and profile viewing within the Coocook application. It includes methods for user registration, profile display, password reset, email verification, and related workflows.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::User
classes.description: Catalyst controller class handling user account operations such as registration, profile display, password recovery, and email verification.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to load user object based on username parameter, used as a base for other actions.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays user profile, including organizations and projects, with access control.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Displays registration form, handles initial registration page setup.

methods.name: post_register
methods.description: Handles user registration form submission, validates input, creates user, and sends verification email.

methods.name: post_recover
methods.description: Processes password recovery request, sends recovery email if user exists.

methods.name: reset_password
methods.description: Displays password reset form if token is valid.

methods.name: post_reset_password
methods.description: Processes new password submission, updates user password, and confirms reset.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Handles email verification via token, marks email as verified.
